claim_one_line: THE ATLAS IS BLIND IN AN EPOCH, AND THE BLINDNESS IS WHERE THE PROGRAMME NOW LIVES. B806's concentration statistic fell THROUGH the 0.85 floor its lock defended, and the floor was NOT bumped: B829 set the precedent that this tripwire is answered by RE-DERIVING, and the re-derivation found something sharper than drift. THE SERIES: B806 stated 0.933, B829 re-derived 0.8845, B1008 measures 0.8496 over 924 probes. THE BREACH PREDATES THIS SESSION: measured at HEAD before B1007 existed it was 0.8494, and B1007's own probe moved it UP by 0.0002 -- SO THE LAST BANKED ARC SHIPPED WITH THIS LOCK RED, and with test_b833's routing lock red too, both found only when a full suite was finally run. IT IS NOT DRIFT, IT IS EPOCH STRUCTURE: top-3 coverage by band is 0.739 (B1-200), 0.995 (B201-400), 0.960 (B401-600), 0.886 (B601-800), 0.629 (B801-900), 0.709 (B901-1010) -- peaking at 0.995 in the era the lexicon was authored to describe and falling to 0.629 in the SM-structure campaign, so THE AGGREGATE IS A WEIGHTED AVERAGE ACROSS AN INSTRUMENT THAT WORKS IN ONE ERA AND NOT ANOTHER. THE DISCRIMINATING FACT, separating vocabulary-drift from blindness: MOTIF DENSITY HALVES, 5.95 motifs per probe at B201-400 against 2.98 at B801-900, while any_motif STAYS HIGH (1.000 to 0.921) -- so recent arcs are NOT INVISIBLE, THEY ARE UNDER-LABELLED, matching about 3 old words where their predecessors matched about 6. Both effects are present, the local top-3 does shift with z3_generation and amphichiral_cp surfacing recently, but DENSITY IS THE DOMINANT TERM. THE ROOT CAUSE IS 14 FOR 14: the lexicon's own header freezes its grounding at knowledge/K001..K022, the EARLY knowledge base, and counted over the 183 arcs at B800+ against concepts chosen from the campaign's own vocabulary BEFORE counting, NOT ONE has a word in the lexicon -- the 27 (52 arcs), E6 (49), chirality (38), measurement (34), rank (29), generation (28), cascade (28), centralizer (24), observer (16), hypercharge (13), anomaly (12), Higgs (11), value layer (5), Maass (4). WHAT THIS DOES TO B806 IS STRENGTHEN IT: B806's finding was that 3 motifs covering >90 percent is a statement about the labels and not about the object, and THE EPOCH STRUCTURE IS A SHARPER PROOF OF EXACTLY THAT, since a statistic about the OBJECT would be STABLE while this one is FITTED TO AN ERA (0.995 where the labels were authored, 0.63 where they were not) -- B806's THESIS SURVIVES ITS OWN NUMBER FALLING and is better evidenced by the fall than by the original 93.3 percent. THE CONSEQUENCE THAT MATTERS: the Recurrence Atlas exists TO RE-ORIENT, query.py card being the documented entry point for a seat picking up the work, and ITS RELIABILITY IS NOW KNOWN TO BE EPOCH-DEPENDENT AND WEAKEST EXACTLY WHERE THE PROGRAMME CURRENTLY IS -- a seat querying the atlas about the cascade, the 27, rank or chirality is querying an instrument with NO WORD FOR ANY OF THEM. DELIBERATELY NOT DONE HERE: WIDENING THE LEXICON, since adding 14 words would change EVERY MOTIF COUNT IN THE REPOSITORY and silently re-date every recurrence claim, and B806's whole point is that what the instrument can see is a CHOICE -- that is a sealed decision of its own, registered as a lead and NOT taken as a side effect of a suite repair. SCOPE: an INSTRUMENT arc about the atlas, asserting no new mathematics about the object; no SM quantity involved, Gate 5 untouched; it SUPERSEDES B806's 93.3 percent number and STRENGTHENS B806's thesis, and it changes no claim about the object.
